title: On a class of pluriharmonic mappings in the unit polydisk
summary: In this paper, we introduce and study the class $\mathcal{W}_{\mathcal{H}_n^0}(α)$ of normalized pluriharmonic mappings, characterized by a suitable bound on their second-order partial derivatives. We establish a one-to-one correspondence between this pluriharmonic class and an associated class of holomorphic functions, thereby extending a result of Ghosh and Vasudevarao \cite{Ghosh-Allu-2019} to the setting of several complex variables. Furthermore, we obtain sharp coefficient bounds, growth estimates and a convex combination theorem for functions in $\mathcal{W}_{\mathcal{H}_n^0}(α)$.…
